Terms of Reference   
 
EXTERNAL FINAL EVALUATION  
MdM Consortium Capacity Building and Deployment 
Project– EU Aid Volunteers 
 
 
Publication of the Terms of Reference for the final  external evaluations of two projects 
implemented by Médicos del Mundo within the EU Aid Volunteers initiative.  
(1) Terms of reference for the Evaluation: MdM Cons ortium Capacity Building Project– EU 
Aid Volunteers 
• Budget: maximum 10.000 € (VAT included) 
  
(2) Terms of reference for the Evaluation: MdM Cons ortium Deployment Project – EU Aid 
Volunteers 
• Budget: maximum 10.000 € (VAT included) 
 
A separate evaluation proposal will be submitted for each project. 
The intention in publishing the Terms of Reference of the two evaluations simultaneously is to 
award their execution to the same person or organization. 
The deadline for submission of applications will be  22 November 2019 to the following email 
address: 
ramon.esteso@medicosdelmundo.org  and evaluacion@medicosdelmundo.org
